identity.individuality_rule: Two Kindlekin of the same species are not required to share personality, temperament, affection style, social behavior, preferences, fears, habits, or reactions.

personality.behavior_rule: Personality rolls change how this individual Kindlekin expresses an intent. They do not change the underlying biological need.

preference_discovery.discovery_rule: Repeated experiences gradually establish the individual Kindlekin's preferences rather than assigning universal species favorites.

care_willingness.rule: High bond can increase trust and willingness, but does not force an individual Kindlekin to become cheerful, social, affectionate, energetic, or obedient.

level_3_to_30_skill_design_proposal.notes: Fire design reference only, not an unlock table or playable registry. Descriptions are themes, not approved mechanics. Maximum MP = (base Mana + allocated Mana + applicable passive Mana) * 3. MAGI determines magical power. Physical basic attacks are free; special skills require approved MP costs. Existing Mend costs 1 MP. Proposed costs remain null. Design Lowform Moltikin uses verified frontend/web/src/kith/assets/startepets/lowform/lowform_moltikin.png. player_skill_decisions.replacement_semantics: Future approved flow only: existing level-up animation with unchanged timing; show four skill names and descriptions; select one and confirm. Learn once with server-validated ownership, eligibility and retry protection. If the authoritative learned-skill capacity is full, explicitly select and confirm one old skill to replace atomically. Cancellation or failure preserves old skills. Do not infer learned capacity from the four local equipped slots. Unselected skills are not learned. Persistence and database compatibility must be verified before activation.
